project.title: Functional Poster for Sonisk Music Film Festival
project.maker: Agency Skogen; art direction Magnus Holder Bjørk
project.format: Poster that unfolds into a newspaper-style festival guide

why: A valuable poster reference because the artifact is both a wall-facing key visual and a useful program. Its black-and-yellow system, sound-derived grid, and foldout behavior make information architecture part of the concept.

compositions.title: Poster-to-program transformation
compositions.study: The poster functions as a striking object when closed, then unfolds into a newspaper-style guide for the festival program.
compositions.reuse: Give a printed key visual a second useful state when the audience needs both recognition at a distance and dense event information.

compositions.title: Identity derived from the subject
compositions.study: The European Design Awards case describes a grid derived from the festival logo, with the logo itself generated from sound.
compositions.reuse: Derive graphic geometry from the event's medium or behavior so the visual system explains what the event is about without illustration.

assets.notes: Black and yellow provide a compact, high-contrast system that supports both poster impact and program legibility.
assets.reuse: Keep the palette intentionally narrow when a poster needs to survive both display distance and information-heavy interior panels.

assets.notes: The foldout format turns a promotional surface into a tactile schedule and guide.
assets.reuse: Treat editorial density as a planned second state, not an afterthought added below the hero image.

implementation.format: Folded print poster that expands into a program
implementation.notes: The award case documents the transformation, palette, sound-generated logo/grid relationship, and credits. The linked video assets remain external and are not copied.

capture.attribution: Agency Skogen; Magnus Holder Bjørk, Espen Varslot, and Maia Arstad for Sonisk Music Film Festival
